topic: What are the challenges of integrating real measured channel data into antenna pattern modeling for EE-optimal precoding?
consensus_response: The integration of real measured channel data into antenna pattern modeling poses significant challenges due to non-linear effects, multi-user interference, and varying environmental conditions. The physical mechanism involves array factor, interference, and spacing effects on system performance. Precoding techniques require perfect knowledge of CSI at the transmitter but may not account for non-linear effects introduced by on-board amplifiers. A reliable antenna pattern model must accurately capture the dynamic behavior of satellite channels under various environmental conditions.
reference_context: Satellite communications face challenges in integrating real measured channel data due to non-linear effects, multi-user interference, and varying environmental conditions. The XPD parameter varies with environment: 15 dB open rural, 6 dB suburban, 5 dB urban. Precoding techniques require perfect CSI knowledge at the transmitter but may not account for non-linear effects introduced by on-board amplifiers.
